🚨 ALERT — Exploit on Ethereum

@UNCX_token Smart Token Vesting was drained of five ERC-20s worth ≈$87.7K at parent-block spot prices. 

The exploit contract retained ≈$85.6K in EDGEN, ZC, PEPECOIN, LO0P and PAAL; after 0.5624 ETH in fees/gas, estimated mark-to-market profit was ≈$84.2K. 

Root cause:
VestingManager.release() subtracts claimed shares from global _totalTokenShares but leaves them in the position's _depositedShares. 
After release → topUpVesting(), cancel() calculates sharesToRemove from the full lifetime _depositedShares without subtracting schedule released, 

so already-released shares are removed from the global total a second time. 

The attacker used a direct donation to magnify this stale-share debit, 

corrupted the denominator, then released a second attacker-owned vesting to take tokens backing unrelated users.

Attack tx: https://etherscan.io/tx/0x352065378c4a41b77e5b6a1e5b5616cd2886c3e1a2c87ed3db8e5ddddc23823d

Attacker: 0x78c9b11853e4f183a34c63ffd1924d2319a2f

Shareholders,

NET trades at about $170 against $163.62 of onchain backing per NET, a premium of three percent, with the inverse bond bidding under it at $161.19. 

For the first time since genesis the price and the number behind it are the same.

From zero

NetNet opened on July 17 with $0. 87 days later, the Treasury holds $24.53M and the Sleeve holds ~$4M of Stock Tokens and positions. 

How we get paid

There is no team allocation of NET, no salary drawn from the Treasury, and no share of the tax. Management is paid through pTEAM, our pToken in the tradition of pOHM. It is an option to mint NET at a strike of one USDG, against a cap of 15 percent of circulating supply. Every term is immutable and disclosed in full on the Management Compensation page of our docs, under pTEAM options. Every exercise is logged as an event on the contract, and the figures below are read from those events.

What we did with it

We exercised 13,320 NET of pTEAM in 192 clips between July 24 and September
